summary.text: Alyssa Weaver is the Greens candidate for Narracan at the 2026 Victorian election. She is a disability support worker, a mother and an author of children's books from Gippsland. She stood for the Greens in the January 2023 Narracan supplementary election, receiving 11.1 per cent of first preferences.

occupation.text: Disability support worker and children's book author

priorities.text: The values of equality, fairness and inclusion are so important to me.
Real action on climate change and more affordable housing
Equal access to health care, education and housing whatever a person's disability, location or income
Better infrastructure funding and help with living costs across Gippsland

summary.text: Ben Lucas is the One Nation candidate for Narracan at the 2026 Victorian election. According to the ABC's candidate notes, he grew up in Drouin, served in the Australian Army for seven years, in ordnance and then infantry, then trained as a plumber before buying a gym in the town, which he still runs. He has twice been elected to Baw Baw Shire Council.

sources.title: Narracan: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Geoff Dethlefs is the Family First candidate for Narracan at the 2026 Victorian election. He is a retired teacher and school principal who has taught in several states and for a year in the United States, mainly in Christian schools since 1983, and he has more recently been pastor of a small church in west Gippsland. He holds arts, education and master's degrees from the University of Sydney, and he was Family First's candidate for Monash at the 2025 federal election.

priorities.text: Reliable baseload power from coal, gas or hydro, with nuclear power seriously considered
Protecting prime farmland and the economy from energy policies he considers too costly

summary.text: Jannette Langley is Labor's candidate for Narracan at the 2026 Victorian election. She lives in Drouin, having earlier lived in Yarragon, and works as a personal care assistant after a career in the public service. Wikipedia lists a Jannette Langley as a Labor candidate for Gippsland at the 2022 federal election and on Labor's Eastern Victoria upper-house ticket in 2022, but no source links those candidacies to her.

summary.text: Moss Page is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Narracan at the 2026 Victorian election. Born in Iran and trained as an engineer, he spent time studying and working in Japan, China and New Zealand, then settled in Australia about 13 years ago and has made Drouin his home for around nine years. He works in disability and education support and belongs to the Health and Community Services Union (HACSU).

priorities.text: A scheme modelled on the PBS to keep basic groceries affordable
Ending corporate donations to political parties, and more transparency
Affordable housing, well-funded public services and fair wages

sources.title: Narracan: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Wayne Farnham is the Liberal MP for Narracan. He won the seat at a supplementary election in January 2023, which was held separately because the Nationals candidate died during the 2022 campaign. He has held shadow assistant minister roles in planning, housing and building, and is seeking re-election in Narracan in 2026.
